meaning:
1) Tirshatha-governor
1a) a title used by the Persian governor in Judea
1a1) Nehemiah used this title

elsewhere.note: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.
The governor told that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.
